lines.text: Seated on the floor, the person remains motionless, calm and suspended, keeping the body compact and still.
The seated person begins subtle self-rocking, slightly shifting the torso and cautiously extending the limbs as if testing whether movement is possible.
Still seated, the person gradually becomes more active, making small controlled adjustments of the torso and limbs as movement slowly starts.
The person gradually moves away from where they started, travelling little by little across the floor while remaining low and seated in the same overall pose.
Now in a different place on the floor, the person settles back into the original seated pose and becomes quiet and still.
